title: Closed-Loop Dual-Reference Guidance for Accent Control in Cross-Lingual Voice Cloning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zero-shot cross-lingual voice cloning often carries the reference speaker's accent into the target language. We propose closed-loop dual-reference guidance, which pairs the original reference with a reusable native anchor constructed by voice conversion (VC). The references initialize separate language-model (LM) states that guide a shared acoustic trajectory; each completed patch then updates both states, keeping their generated histories aligned with the emitted speech. Anchor construction runs once per speaker, and online synthesis uses a frozen TTS model without per-utterance VC. On 20 held-out French speakers, the fixed setting $\lambda^{\!*}=0.33$ reduces residual French LID mass by 73\% versus direct cloning, at an ECAPA similarity cost of only $0.042$; relative to anchor-only cloning, it recovers $0.155$. The method achieves the lowest mean WER ($0.009$) and highest mean GOP ($4.750$) among the held-out test arms. In blinded pr

translated_title: 跨语言语音克隆中用于口音控制的闭环双参考引导方法
translated_abstract: 零样本跨语言语音克隆常常会将参考说话人的口音带入目标语言中。我们提出闭环双参考引导方法，将原始参考与通过语音转换（VC）构建的可复用母语锚点进行配对。这两个参考分别初始化各自独立的语言模型（LM）状态，共同引导一条共享的声学轨迹；每个完成的语音片段随后会更新这两个状态，使其生成历史与实际输出的语音保持对齐。锚点构建每个说话人仅需执行一次，在线合成使用冻结的TTS模型，无需逐句进行语音转换。在20个保留测试的法语说话人上，固定设置 λ*=0.33 与直接克隆相比，将残余的法语LID质量降低了73%，ECAPA相似度损失仅为0.042；相对于仅使用锚点的克隆，该方法恢复了0.155的相似度。在保留测试组中，该方法实现了最低的平均WER（0.009）和最高的平均GOP（4.750）。
tldr: 提出闭环双参考引导方法，通过将原始参考与语音转换构建的母语锚点配对并动态更新语言模型状态，有效消除跨语言语音克隆中的源语言口音，在仅损失极小说话人相似度的前提下显著提升目标语言的发音质量。
en_tdlr: A closed-loop dual-reference guidance method pairs the original reference with a voice-converted native anchor and dynamically updates LM states to eliminate source-language accent in cross-lingual voice cloning, achieving substantially better target-language pronunciation with minimal speaker similarity loss.
